title: The needs-you line names a refused query-log delivery although the panel counts no undelivered entry
goal: mon_needs.delivery_entries returns no entry while the querylog panel's data counts no undelivered entry, as mon_querylog.alerts does, so the needs-you line and the alert agree

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_needs as m;last={'outcome':'refused','why':'sync exit 2'};r=m.delivery_entries({'last_delivery':last,'undelivered':0});print(len(r));sys.exit(1 if r else 0)

import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import mon_needs as m
last={'outcome':'refused','why':'sync exit 2'}
zero=m.delivery_entries({'last_delivery':last,'undelivered':0})
some=m.delivery_entries({'last_delivery':last,'undelivered':3})
unknown=m.delivery_entries({'last_delivery':last})
print(len(zero),len(some),len(unknown))
sys.exit(0 if not zero and len(some)==1 and len(unknown)==1 else 1)
